title: The Ultimate Transformation
paragraphs: §The Revelation of Jesus

Alright, so here's the deal. This is the inside scoop on Jesus, the Messiah. God gave him this vision to show his crew what's about to go down. He sent an angel, like a heavenly messenger, to deliver it to his boy, John. And John is spilling all the tea, everything he saw, the real story of Jesus.
Hey, if you're reading this, or even just listening to it and taking it seriously, you're gonna be blessed. Seriously. Because time is running out.

What up, it's your boy John, writing to the seven churches out in Asia. Shout out to you from God, the one who's always been, who is, and who's coming back. And from the seven spirits chilling before his throne. And, of course, from Jesus Christ, the ultimate ride-or-die, the first to have a miraculous transformation from the dead, and the king of all kings on Earth. All the props and power to Jesus, who loves us so much he took the fall for our mistakes, washing us clean. He made us a kingdom, priests for his Dad, forever. And get this, he's on his way back! He's gonna roll in on the clouds, and everyone will see him, even the haters who ghosted him and the ones who took him out. People from everywhere are gonna be panicking. You better believe it.

The big boss, God, says, "I'm the beginning and the end, the whole alphabet. I'm the God who is, who was, and who's about to show up and flex his power. I'm the one in charge, the ultimate powerhouse."

So, I, John, your bro in all this, going through the same struggles and waiting for Jesus' kingdom just like you, got exiled to this island called Patmos for talking about God and Jesus. It was a Sunday, and I was deep in prayer when I heard this crazy loud voice behind me, like a trumpet blast. It said, "Write down everything you see and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea." I whipped around to see who was talking.

And what I saw was insane. There was this gold lampstand with seven branches, and right in the middle was someone who looked like the Son of Man. He was wearing a long robe with a gold sash, and his hair was white as snow. His eyes were like blazing fire, and his feet glowed like they were forged in a furnace. His voice was like a roaring waterfall, and he was holding seven stars in his right hand. A super-sharp sword was coming out of his mouth, and his face was as bright as the sun at full blast.

When I saw him, I just collapsed at his feet like I was dead. But he put his right hand on me and said, "Don't be scared. I'm the first and the last. I'm the living one. I died, but look, I'm alive forever! And I've got the keys to Death and Hell. So, write all this down: what you're seeing now, and what's gonna happen later. You wanna know the secret of the seven stars in my hand and the seven gold lampstands? The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches themselves."

title: A Few Pep Talks and a Major Roasting
paragraphs: §Letters to the Churches (Part 1)
Alright, so this is a message for the church in Ephesus. The guy holding seven stars like a boss, the one who strolls through the seven golden lampstands, he's got something to say:

“Hey, I see you grinding. You’ve been working hard and haven’t quit. I know you can’t stand shady characters and you totally roast the fakes who claim they’re apostles but are just posers. You’ve stuck with it and been brave for me, never getting tired.

“But here’s the deal—you’ve kinda ghosted your first love. What’s up with that? You’ve seriously lost your way, like a total face-plant. You need to get back to how you were at the beginning. Seriously, hurry up, because I’m about to pull the plug on your whole operation.
“But on the bright side, you do hate what those Nicolaitan fools are doing. I can’t stand them either.
“So listen up! If you’re a real winner, I’m giving you a special access to the Tree of Life buffet in God’s paradise.”
Next up, a message for the church in Smyrna. The one who’s the beginning and the end, who died and came back to life, says:
“I see you’re going through a tough time, totally broke and in pain, but you’re actually rich. I also hear the trash talk from those who say they’re legit but are really on Team Satan.

“Don’t be scared of what’s coming. The Devil’s gonna try and get you locked up for a bit, just to test you. It’s not gonna last forever. Don’t give up, even if it means you could die. Stick with it, and I’ve got a winner’s crown waiting for you.
“Pay attention! If you overcome this, you won’t have to worry about the ‘second death.’ You’re safe.”
Now for the church in Pergamum. The one with words that cut like a razor-sharp sword says:
“I know where you live—right in Satan’s backyard. But you’ve stayed loyal to me and never denied me, even when things got crazy and my boy Antipas was killed right there on Satan’s turf.

“But why are you letting that Balaam crew hang around? That guy was a total snake, messing with Israel and getting them into all sorts of trouble. And you’re also putting up with the Nicolaitans, who are just as bad.
“That’s gotta stop. Turn it around, or I’m coming to deal with them myself with my sword-sharp words. I’m not playing.
“Listen up! To everyone who wins, I’m giving some of the secret heavenly food. I’ll also give you a special stone with a new secret name on it, just for you.”
Finally, a message for the church in Thyatira. God’s Son, with eyes like fire and feet like polished bronze, says this:
“I see what you’re doing, and it’s awesome. The love, the faith, the service—you’re crushing it and getting better every day.

“But you’re letting that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet, lead my people astray with her fake religion. I gave her a chance to change, but she loves her little god-business. So I’m about to take her and her followers down. I’ll even take out their followers to show everyone I’m not impressed by appearances. I see everything, and you get what you deserve.
“But for the rest of you in Thyatira who aren’t into all that crazy Devil-worshipping stuff, I won’t make things harder for you. Just hold on to what you’ve got until I get there.

“For everyone who keeps going and doesn’t give up, I’m giving you power to rule over nations. You’ll be like a shepherd-king with an iron staff, and their resistance will be as weak as clay pots. That’s the gift my Father gave me, and I’m passing it on to you—plus the Morning Star!
“If you have ears, you better listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.”

title: God Roasts the Fakers
paragraphs: §Letters to the Churches (Part 2)
**A Message to the Church in Sardis**

"Hey, listen up, Sardis! This is a message from the one who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I see right through you. You have a reputation for being alive and full of energy, but you're basically a zombie. Get up and get your act together before it's too late! You're in a desperate situation. Remember the awesome gift you were given and the message you heard? Grab onto it and turn back to God. If you keep hitting snooze and ignoring God, I'll show up when you least expect it, like a thief in the night.

But there are a few of you who haven't gotten lost in all the worldly drama. You guys are the real MVPs, and you'll walk with me in the victory parade. The winners of this fight will have their names permanently written in the Book of Life, and I'll personally introduce them to my Father and his angel squad. If you have ears, you better listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches."
§**A Message to the Church in Philadelphia**

"To the church in Philadelphia, this is a message from the one who is holy and true, the one who holds the key of David. What he opens, no one can shut, and what he shuts, no one can open. I see what you've been doing. I've opened a door for you that no one can slam shut. I know you don't have a lot of strength, but you've stuck with me and didn't ghost me when things got tough.

And as for those fakers who claim to be on my team but are really on Team Satan? I'm going to expose them. They'll have to admit that you're the ones I truly love. Because you've been patient and held on to my word, I'll keep you safe during the time of testing that's coming for the whole world. I'm coming soon, so hold on to what you have, and don't let anyone snatch your crown. The winners will become pillars in God's temple, and I'll write my new name on them, along with the name of my God and the name of the new Jerusalem. If you have ears, you better listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches."
§**A Message to the Church in Laodicea**

"To the church in Laodicea, this is a message from the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God's creation. I know all about you, and I'm not impressed. You're not on fire for me, but you're not against me either. You're just lukewarm, and it makes me want to spit you out of my mouth. You brag about being rich and not needing anything, but you're blind to the fact that you're actually poor, naked, and pitiful.

So here's my advice: buy gold from me that has been purified by fire, and you'll truly be rich. Buy white clothes from me so you can cover your shameful nakedness. And buy medicine for your eyes so you can finally see. I'm only hard on the people I love. I correct them and guide them so they can be their best. So get up, turn your life around, and chase after God.

Look, I'm standing at the door and knocking. If you hear my voice and open the door, I'll come in and we can hang out. The winners will get a best seat at the head table with me, just like I won and sat down with my Father on his throne. If you have ears, you better listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches."

title: The Ultimate Sneak Peek
paragraphs: §The Throne Room

So, I was just looking around, and BAM! A door to heaven was just hanging open. Then this voice, sounding like a trumpet, the same one I heard before, was like, 'Get up here! I'm about to show you the next level.'

Instantly, I was in this crazy awesome worship mode. And here's the thing—there was a throne in heaven, and someone was sitting on it. He was shining with colors like amber and fire, with a glowing green halo. Around the main throne, there were 24 other thrones, with 24 elders sitting on them, all decked out in white robes and gold crowns. It was the ultimate throne room of heaven. Lightning and thunder were booming from the throne, and seven blazing torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were right in front. And in front of the throne, there was something that looked like a sea made of crystal. Super clear.

Then, I saw four creatures prowling around the throne. These things were covered in eyes, front and back. The first one looked like a lion, the second like an ox, the third had a human face, and the fourth was like a soaring eagle. They each had six wings and were covered with eyes, inside and out. And they just kept chanting, 24/7, no breaks:
'Holy, holy, holy is God, the ultimate boss, the one who was, who is, and who's coming back.'

Every time these creatures gave glory and thanks to the one on the throne, the 24 elders would totally bow down. They'd worship the one who lives forever and ever, and they'd throw their crowns down at the throne, shouting:
'You deserve all the glory, honor, and power, our God! You made everything. It all exists because you wanted it to.'

title: The Ultimate Unboxing
paragraphs: §The Lamb and the Scroll

So, I'm looking, and I see this scroll in the right hand of the One on the Throne. This thing is sealed up tight, like a super-exclusive drop, with seven seals. Then this mega-powerful angel with a voice like a thunderclap yells out, "Who's got the cred to open this scroll? Who can break these seals?"

But, crickets. Absolutely no one in heaven, on earth, or anywhere else had the juice to open it or even peek inside. I was totally gutted, just bawling my eyes out because no one was worthy enough to get this thing open.

Then one of the elders tells me, "Chill out, don't cry. Look, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the OG from David's line, he's the champion. He's earned the right to open the scroll and its seven seals."

I looked, and right in the middle of the throne, the creatures, and the elders, I see a Lamb. He looked like he'd been taken out, but he was standing tall. This Lamb was a total boss—he had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out to flex all over the world. He walks up to the One on the Throne and takes the scroll.

The second he grabs it, the four creatures and the twenty-four elders just hit the deck and worshiped the Lamb. They all had harps and golden bowls of incense, which are like the prayers of God's crew. Then they dropped a new track:

"You are the one! You get to take the scroll and pop the seals. You paid the ultimate price, buying back people for God from every crew, language, and nation on earth. You made them a kingdom of priests for our God, and now they're the ones who'll rule."
I looked again and heard a massive choir of angels—literally millions of them—surrounding the throne, the creatures, and the elders. They were all singing at the top of their lungs:
"The Lamb who was taken out is worthy! He gets all the power, the riches, the wisdom, the strength, the honor, the glory, and the blessing!"
Then I heard *everything* and *everyone*—in heaven, on earth, under the earth, in the sea—the whole universe, singing together:
"To the One on the throne and to the Lamb, be all the blessing, honor, glory, and power forever and ever!"
The four living creatures were all like, "YES!" And the elders fell down and worshiped.

title: The Apocalypse Horsemen Drop In
paragraphs: §The Six Seals

So, I'm watching as the Lamb just rips open the first of seven seals. One of the big angel-creatures yells, "Let's go!" And boom, this white horse appears. The man riding it has a bow and gets a winner's crown. He just rides off, totally owning everyone, a real victory lap.

Then the Lamb cracks the second seal. The second creature shouts, "Next up!" A fiery red horse shows up. Its rider's job is to basically cancel peace on Earth and get everyone to fight each other. He's carrying this massive sword, so you know it's serious. Total chaos starter.

Next, the third seal gets broken. The third creature is like, "You're on!" And out comes a black horse. This rider is holding a pair of scales, like for weighing stuff. Then a voice from near the creatures says, "A whole day's pay for a loaf of bread, or three for some cheaper grain. But don't even think about touching the good stuff like oil and wine." Basically, everything's gonna get crazy expensive.

When the fourth seal is ripped, the fourth creature yells, "Get out there!" I look, and it's this sickly, pale horse. The rider's name is literally Death, and his sidekick, Hell, is right behind him. They get permission to wipe out a quarter of the world with war, starvation, plagues, and even wild animals.

He breaks the fifth seal, and I see all these souls under the altar. They were the ones who got taken out for sticking with God's word. They're all shouting, "How much longer, God? You're the boss, holy and true! When are you gonna step in and give us justice for our murders?" They each get a fresh white robe and are told to just chill for a bit, to wait until the rest of their friends and crew who are supposed to be martyrs join them.

Then I watched as he tore open the sixth seal. The whole earth just gets rocked by a massive earthquake. The sun goes pitch black, the moon turns blood-red, and stars start falling from the sky like when you shake a fig tree super hard. The sky itself just rolls up like a scroll. Mountains and islands are sliding all over the place. It's absolute chaos. Then pandemonium—kings, princes, generals, rich and strong, along with everyone else, slave or free, running for cover. They're hiding in caves and under rocks, yelling at the mountains, "Fall on us! Hide us from the guy on the throne and from the Lamb's anger! The big day of their rage is here, and who can even handle it?"

title: The honored List
paragraphs: §The 144,000 Sealed

Right away, I saw these four major angels posted up at the four corners of the world. They were putting the four winds on lockdown, so not even a breeze could stir on the planet or the oceans. Not a single leaf was moving.

Then another angel, rolling in from the east, showed up holding a special seal from the living God. He shouted out to the four angels who had the green light to wreck the earth and sea, "Hold up! Don't mess with the land or the water or even a single tree until we've marked God's crew on their foreheads."

I heard the final count of who made the list: a massive 144,000 people. They were the top recruits from all the tribes of Israel. It was a full roster: 12,000 from Judah, 12,000 from Reuben, 12,000 from Gad, 12,000 from Asher, 12,000 from Naphtali, 12,000 from Manasseh, 12,000 from Simeon, 12,000 from Levi, 12,000 from Issachar, 12,000 from Zebulun, 12,000 from Joseph, and 12,000 from Benjamin.

Then I looked again, and wow—the crowd was insane. You couldn't even count them all. People from every country, every tribe, every background, and every language were there. They were all standing in front of the throne and the Lamb, decked out in clean white robes and waving palm branches. They were all shouting at the top of their lungs, "Our God on the throne and the Lamb are the ones who saved us!"

All the angels, the elders, and the four crazy-looking creatures circled the throne, dropped to their knees, and started worshiping God, chanting, "You know it! All the props, the glory, the wisdom, the thanks, the honor, the power, and the strength belong to our God forever and ever. Totally!"

Out of nowhere, one of the elders turns to me and asks, "Hey, who are all these people in the white robes? Where'd they even come from?" I was totally stumped and just said, "Listen, I have no clue. You're the one who knows."

He broke it down for me: "These are the people who survived the ultimate nightmare. They've had a miraculous transformation, washing their robes clean with the Lamb's blood. That's why they get to stand here in front of God's throne, serving him 24/7 in his temple. And the Big Boss on the throne will always have their back. They'll never be hungry or thirsty again, and they won't get burned by the scorching sun. The Lamb on the throne will be their guide, leading them to fresh springs of life. And God himself will wipe away every single tear."

title: The Trumpet Squad Brings the Pain
paragraphs: §The Seventh Seal and the Trumpets
When the Lamb cracked open the seventh seal, it got dead silent in heaven. Like, for a whole thirty minutes, you could hear a pin drop. It was the ultimate calm before the storm.

Then I saw the seven angels who are always in readiness before God, and they each got a trumpet. Another angel showed up with a gold pot for incense and stood by the altar. He got a ton of incense to mix with the prayers from all of God's crew and offered it up on the golden altar right in front of the throne. The smoke from the prayers, all mixed with the incense, floated up to God from the angel's hand. It was like sending a super-powered DM straight to the big guy.

Then, the angel took that same pot, filled it with fire from the altar, and just chucked it down to Earth. Boom! Thunder, crazy noises, lightning flashes, and a massive earthquake. Things were about to get real.

The seven angels with the trumpets got ready to play. The first one let it rip, and bam! Hail and fire mixed with blood rained down. A third of the planet got torched. A third of all the trees and every single blade of grass? Burnt to a crisp. Total wipeout.

The second angel blew his trumpet. This time, something like a giant, flaming mountain got yeeted into the ocean. A third of the sea turned into blood, a third of all the sea creatures died, and a third of the ships just sank. Straight up ghosted.

The third angel's turn. A massive star, blazing like a torch, fell out of the sky and wrecked a third of the rivers and springs. The star's name was 'Wormwood,' which is as bad as it sounds. It poisoned a third of the water, and a bunch of people died from drinking it. Major L.
The fourth angel sounded his trumpet. Suddenly, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars went dark. It was a partial blackout, day and night. Super eerie.

Then I looked up and saw a lone eagle soaring high in the sky, screaming its head off. It was yelling, "Doom! Doom! Doom to everyone on Earth!" It was a warning that three more angels were about to blow their trumpets, and things were going to get even crazier. The next level of destruction was loading.

title: The Monster Apocalypse Gets Real
paragraphs: §The Fifth and Sixth Trumpets

So the fifth angel blasts his trumpet, and boom! I see this star just face-plant from the sky. This 'star' gets a key to a place called the Abyss, which is basically a bottomless pit of pure doom. He unlocks it, and this awful smoke just starts pouring out, like a volcano of smog. It's so thick it completely blacks out the sun and sky.

Then, out of the smoke, these gnarly locust-scorpion things start crawling out. They get their marching orders: 'Don't mess with the plants, just go after the people who don't have the seal of God on their foreheads.' Their mission wasn't to kill, but to torture them for five straight months. The pain was supposed to be like a scorpion sting, which is seriously no joke. It's so bad that people will be begging to die, but death just ghosts them.

These locusts looked like something out of a nightmare. They were geared up like warhorses, but with human faces, long hair like a girl's, and teeth like a lion. Total chaos. They had iron armor, and their wings sounded like a whole army of chariots charging. Their tails had stingers, and that's what they used to wreck people for five months. Their leader was the Angel of the Abyss, whose name is basically 'Destroyer.' So yeah, a real fun guy.
The first round of awfulness is over. But wait, there are two more to go.
Next, the sixth angel sounds his trumpet. I hear a voice from the big golden altar in front of God, telling the angel, 'Unleash the four angels who are tied up at the Euphrates River.'

So these four angels are let loose. They were prepped for this exact moment—down to the hour—to wipe out a third of all people. Their army was massive, like 200 million horsemen. I saw them in the vision: the riders had armor that looked like fire, and the horses had lion heads that breathed fire, smoke, and sulfur. These three things—the fire, smoke, and sulfur—were their weapons, and they took out a third of humanity. The horses were deadly from both ends; their tails were like snakes with heads that just caused chaos.

You'd think after seeing all that, the people who survived would get their act together, right? Wrong. They just kept on living their lives, worshiping fake gods and idols made of gold and stone that can't do anything. They didn't have a change of heart at all. They just doubled down on their old ways—murdering, doing weird magic stuff, being unfaithful, and stealing. Total chaos.

title: The Angel and the Snack-Sized Scroll
paragraphs: §The Little Book

Then I saw this other totally jacked angel dropping out of the sky. He was literally wrapped in a cloud, had a rainbow for a halo, and his face was shining like the sun. His legs were like pillars of fire, super intense. He was holding this little book, like a mini-scroll. He planted one foot on the ocean and the other on the land, and then he just roars like a lion. As soon as he roared, these Seven Thunders answered back, like a crazy sound system. I was about to write down what the thunders said, but a voice from heaven was like, "Nah, keep that on the down-low. Don't write any of it."

So the angel who was standing on the sea and the land raises his hand and makes a super-serious promise. He swore by God, the one who made everything, that the waiting was over. As soon as the seventh angel blew his trumpet, God's secret plan, the one he told all the prophets about, was finally going to happen. No more delays.

Then the voice from heaven hit me up again, "Go get that open book from the angel who's standing on the sea and the land." So I walked up to the angel and was like, "Can I get that little book?" He said, "Yeah, take it and eat it. It'll taste super sweet, like honey, but then it'll mess up your stomach." So I took the book from him and ate it. And yeah, it was sweet like honey in my mouth, but as soon as I swallowed it, my stomach felt awful. Then they told me, "You've got to go back and tell the future again, this time to a whole bunch of different people, nations, and their leaders."

title: God's Two-Man Temple Guards vs. The Beast
paragraphs: §The Two Witnesses

So, here's the thing about this stick, right? And this voice is like, "Hey, go measure God's Temple, the altar, and count everyone worshiping inside." But don't even bother with the outer court. That place is getting wrecked. It's been handed over to the outsiders, and they're gonna wreck the Holy City for 42 months straight."

Then God says, "But check it, I'm sending in my two witnesses. They'll be dressed in rags, but they'll be spitting truth for 1,260 days. These guys are like the two olive trees and lampstands you hear about, total bosses for God on earth. And get this: if anyone tries to mess with them, they literally breathe fire and roast the haters. Poof! They can also stop the rain, turn all the water to blood, and basically unleash any disaster they want, whenever they want. They're not playing."

Once they're done with their mission, this gnarly Beast crawls up from the Abyss to throw down. It actually beats them and takes them out, leaving their bodies in the street of the Great City—the same place their Master got crucified. For three and a half days, the whole world is just staring at them, not even letting them be buried. People are partying, celebrating like, "Finally! Those guys were such a buzzkill!" because the two prophets were always calling them out and making them feel bad for their suspicious behavior.

But then, plot twist! After three and a half days, the Spirit of God zaps them back to life. They just stand up, and everyone who was celebrating gets totally freaked out. A loud voice from heaven yells, "Get up here!" and they just float up into a cloud while all their enemies watch, jaws on the floor. Right then, a massive earthquake hits. A tenth of the city collapses, seven thousand people die, and everyone left is so scared they finally start giving props to the God of Heaven.
The second disaster is over, but hold up, the third one is coming in hot.

Then the seventh angel blows his trumpet, and this huge chorus in heaven starts singing, "The world is now officially owned by our God and his Messiah! He's the king forever!" The twenty-four elders who sit on thrones in front of God all drop to their knees and start worshiping, singing, "We're so grateful, God, the All-Powerful, the one who is and was. You just flexed your power and took over. The nations were all angry, but now they get a taste of your wrath. It's judgment day for the dead, and time to reward your crew—the prophets, the saints, and everyone, big or small, who respects you. And it's time to wreck the ones who've been wrecking the earth."

Suddenly, the doors to God's Temple in heaven swing open, and you can see the Ark of the Covenant, clear as day. Then, BAM! Lightning, thunder, a crazy earthquake, and a massive hailstorm. It was epic.

title: The Cosmic Throwdown: Dragon vs. a Super Mom
paragraphs: §The Woman and the Dragon

So, here's the thing, a crazy thing showed up in the sky. There was this lady, totally glowing like she was wearing the sun, standing on the moon, and had a crown made of twelve stars. A total transformation. She was about to have a baby and, yeah, it looked like it hurt a lot.

Then, boom, another sign pops up: this massive, fire-breathing dragon. This thing was a monster—seven heads, ten horns, and a crown on every single head. Talk about extra. It just whips its tail and—bam!—a third of the stars get knocked out of the sky and crash down to Earth. The dragon was creeping, waiting for the lady to have her baby so he could just snatch it and eat it. Seriously messed up.

The lady has her baby, a son who's destined to be the boss of all nations. But before the dragon can make a move, the kid gets teleported straight to God's throne room, totally safe. The mom ghosts the scene and escapes to a secret spot in the desert that God had all set up for her, where she'd be taken care of for 1,260 days.

Then, an all-out war breaks out in heaven. It's Michael and his angel squad versus the dragon and his crew. The dragon's team fought back hard, but they were no match for Michael and his angels. They got totally owned and kicked out of heaven for good. This huge dragon, the OG snake, the one they call the Devil and Satan, who's been tricking the whole world, got thrown down to Earth, and his whole crew got tossed out with him.

Then I heard this loud voice from heaven shouting, "It's on! God's kingdom is here, and the Messiah is flexing his power! The guy who was always accusing our people, roasting them in front of God 24/7, has been thrown out. They beat him because of the Lamb's sacrifice and because they weren't afraid to tell everyone the truth. They weren't obsessed with their own lives; they were ready to die for the cause. So, party on, heavens! But it's gonna be rough for the earth and the sea, because the Devil has crash-landed on your turf. He's totally furious because he knows his time is almost up."

When the dragon realized he'd been yeeted to Earth, he went after the woman who had the baby boy. But she got a major power-up: wings like a giant eagle, so she could fly to her safe house in the desert and chill for a while, safe from the snake. The dragon tried to get her by spewing a whole river of water out of his mouth to wash her away. But the Earth itself had her back and just opened up and swallowed the whole river. The dragon was so mad he couldn't do anything. He was raging, so he went off to start a war with the rest of her kids—all the people who follow God's rules and stick with what Jesus taught.

title: The Ultimate Boss Fight
paragraphs: §The Two Beasts

So, get this. The Dragon, who's like the ultimate baddie, is just chilling by the ocean. Then, this gnarly monster, the Beast, pops out of the water. This thing is seriously decked out. It's got ten horns with crowns and seven heads, and on each head, it's got some majorly disrespectful stuff written. It's a total mashup of animals: looks like a leopard, has paws like a bear, and a mouth like a lion. The Dragon, seeing how epic this Beast is, just hands over all his power, his throne, and all his authority. Like, "Here you go, my guy, go nuts."

One of the Beast's heads looked like it got totally wrecked, like a fatal wound, but then it just healed up, no big deal. The whole world sees this and is completely panicking. They're all like, "Whoa, this Beast is insane!" and start worshipping it. They even start worshipping the Dragon for giving the Beast so much power. Everyone's saying, "This Beast is unbeatable! Who would even try to fight it?"

This Beast has a super loud mouth and is always bragging and saying messed-up things about God. For 42 months, it can do whatever it wants. It's constantly roasting God, his name, and his followers, especially the ones already in heaven. It gets permission to go after God's people and totally owns them. It's got power over every single person on Earth. Basically, anyone whose name wasn't written from the world's foundation in the slaughtered Lamb's Book of Life is going to end up worshiping this Beast.

Then, another Beast shows up, this time from underground. This one has two horns like a lamb, but when it talks, it sounds just like the Dragon. It's basically the first Beast's little sidekick, and its whole job is to make everyone on Earth worship the first Beast, the one that had the crazy transformation after getting a deathblow.

This second Beast is all about cheap tricks and illusions. It's making fire rain down from the sky to impress everyone. It uses this fake magic to trick people into making a statue of the first Beast. Then, it brings the statue to life so it can talk, and it makes a rule that anyone who doesn't worship the statue gets taken out. It forces everyone—rich, poor, powerful, or not—to get a mark on their right hand or forehead. If you don't have the mark, which is the Beast's name or number, you can't buy or sell anything. It's like you're totally ghosted from society.
So, here's a riddle for you. Put on your thinking caps and figure out the Beast's number. It's a human number, and it's 666. Pretty eerie, right?

title: God's honored ones and the Final Smackdown
paragraphs: §The Lamb and the Harvest

Whoa, you won't believe what I saw next. It was insane! The Lamb was just chilling on Mount Zion, and with him was this massive crew, like 144,000 people. These weren't just any randos; they were bought from the earth, firstfruits of the harvest for God and the Lamb, and they had His and the Lamb's names written right on their foreheads, like a permanent backstage pass. Then this sound booms from the sky, super loud like a waterfall and thunder combined, but it was also music. A bunch of harpists were playing this brand-new song for the Throne, the four crazy-looking creatures, and the Elders. But here's the kicker: only the 144,000 could even learn the song. They were the real deal, totally loyal to God, no fakes in the bunch. They followed the Lamb everywhere, no questions asked. They were like the first and best of humanity, a perfect gift to God.

Then I see this angel flying across the sky, and he's got a message for literally everyone on Earth. He's yelling, "Hey, respect God and give him props! It's judgment day, people! Worship the one who made everything—the sky, the dirt, the oceans, all of it!" Right after him, another angel shows up, shouting, "It's over for Babylon! That place is toast! They got everyone hooked on their messed-up lifestyle, and now it's all coming down!" Then a *third* angel flies by, and this one is screaming a serious warning: "If you worship that Beast or its statue, or get its mark on you, you're in for a world of hurt. You're gonna have to drink God's anger straight, no chaser, and get roasted in fire right in front of the holy angels and the Lamb. The smoke from their torment will rise forever. There's no break, no time-out, for anyone who sided with the Beast."

But God's crew, the saints? They're just holding strong, keeping the faith and following the rules. Then a voice from heaven tells me, "Write this down: anyone who dies for the Master from now on is super blessed." And the Spirit was like, "Totally. They get to finally rest from all their hard work, and all the good stuff they did? It all pays off in the end."

I looked up again, and BAM! There's this guy who looks like the Son of Man sitting on a white cloud. He's got a gold crown on and is holding a huge, sharp sickle, like a giant farming tool. Another angel comes out of the Temple and yells at him, "Let's go! It's harvest time! The Earth is ready!" So the guy on the cloud swings his sickle and starts harvesting the whole planet in one go. Then *another* angel with a sharp sickle comes out of the Temple in heaven. And then a final angel, the one in charge of fire, comes from the altar and yells to the angel with the sickle, "Swing that thing! It's time to harvest the Earth's vineyard. The grapes are totally ripe!" So the angel harvests all the grapes and chucks them into this giant winepress—the winepress of God's wrath. They stomped those grapes outside the city, and so much blood came out that it made a river that was as high as a horse's head and went on for 200 miles. Seriously gnarly.

title: The Seven Angels and the Final Smackdown
paragraphs: §The Seven Last Plagues

So, I looked up and saw another wild sight in the sky, totally mind-blowing. There were seven angels, and they were seven of God's angels, carrying the seven final disasters. This was it, the big finale for God's righteous anger. No more messing around.

Then, I saw something that looked like a sea made of glass, glowing with fire. Standing on this fiery glass sea were all the people who had totally owned the Beast and his statue and his whole brand. They were the saved ones who had won, carrying harps from God, totally triumphant over the Beast, his statue, and the number of his name. They started singing this epic victory song, like a remix of a classic hit by Moses and a new track from the Lamb.

They sang, "God, the All-Powerful, you do the most amazing things! You're the King of everyone, and you're always straight-up and true. Who wouldn't respect you, God, and give you a shout-out? You're the only one who is truly holy. All the nations are gonna come and bow down because they see you're making all the right calls."

After that, I saw the main Temple in heaven, the real deal, get thrown wide open. The seven angels with the seven disasters came marching out. They were looking sharp in clean, bright linen clothes with gold sashes, looking like they meant business. Then one of the four living creatures handed them seven golden bowls, filled to the brim with the wrath of God, who lives forever. The whole Temple filled up with smoke from God's glory and power, and nobody could go in until the seven angels had finished their mission and unleashed all seven disasters.

title: The Seven Bowls of Epic Ownage
paragraphs: §The Seven Bowls
Then I heard this mega-loud voice from the Temple in heaven, shouting at the seven angels, "Alright, let's do this! Go dump the seven bowls of God's fury on the world!"
The first angel went for it and poured his bowl on the earth. Instantly, these gnarly, terrible sores broke out on everyone who had the Beast's mark and worshipped his statue. Super horrible.
§The Bowls Keep Coming
The second angel dumped his bowl on the ocean, and the whole thing turned into what looked like thick, dead blood. Every single living thing in the sea was totally ghosted.

Then the third angel poured his bowl on all the rivers and springs, and they turned to blood too. I heard the angel in charge of the waterworks say, "You are so legit, the One who is and always was, the Holy God. Your calls are always the right ones. These guys spilled the blood of your people and prophets, so you're making them drink blood. They're just getting what they had coming to them!" Then the altar itself chimed in, like, "Fact check: TRUE! Oh God, the All-Powerful Boss, your judgments are 100% fair and square!"

The fourth angel poured his bowl on the sun, and it started blasting the world with insane heat, totally scorching people. They were getting torched, but instead of saying sorry and giving God some respect, they just cursed Him for the disasters.

The fifth angel poured his bowl on the Beast's throne, and his whole kingdom went dark. People were in so much pain they were literally chewing on their own tongues. They cursed the God of heaven because of the pain and the sores, but they still wouldn't turn their lives around. Total fail.

The sixth angel dumped his bowl on the huge Euphrates River, and it completely dried up, making a perfect highway for the kings from the East to march their armies across. Then, out of the mouths of the Dragon, the Beast, and the Fake Prophet, I saw three awful demons that looked like frogs. These things were demon spirits doing fake miracles to trick all the world leaders into showing up for a massive battle on the big day of God, the ultimate Sovereign.

Suddenly, a voice says, "Hey, pay attention! I'm showing up when you least expect it, like a thief. You'll be stoked if you're awake and ready for me. But it's gonna be super awkward if you're caught sleeping and running around with no clothes on, totally embarrassed."
So the frog-demons got all the kings to meet up at a place that's called Armageddon in Hebrew.

The seventh angel poured his bowl into the air, and a massive shout came from the throne in the Temple, yelling, "It's DONE!" Then came lightning, thunder, and a monster earthquake, bigger than any earthquake in human history. The great city of Babylon split into three pieces, and cities all over the world crumbled. God hadn't forgotten about Babylon; it was time for her to drink the cup of His pure, unfiltered anger. Every island vanished, and mountains were nowhere to be seen. Then, hailstones the size of boulders, like a hundred pounds each, started falling from the sky, crushing people. And they just kept cursing God because of the hail, which was the most epic, disastrous storm ever.

title: The Shady Queen and the Monster Beast
paragraphs: §The Woman on the Beast

So, one of the seven angels holding those bowls of doom came over to me and was like, "Hey, come here. I'm gonna show you the takedown of the ultimate shady queen who's basically ruling the world. All the big-shot leaders have been buttering up her, and everyone on Earth is basically drunk on her fake lifestyle."

Then, boom, I was in the middle of a desert, and I see this woman riding a gnarly-looking scarlet monster. This beast was covered in insults against God, had seven heads and ten horns. The woman herself was decked out in purple and red, dripping with gold and jewels. She was holding a golden cup, but it was full of the grossest, most terrible things you can imagine. On her forehead, she had a tattoo that said, "THE OG FAKE, MOTHER OF ALL LIES AND EVERYTHING WRONG WITH THE WORLD."

I realized she was ruined, but not on booze. She was drunk on the blood of God's people, the ones who stood up for Jesus. I was totally floored, just staring in disbelief. The angel then said, "Why are you so shocked? Let me break down the mystery of this woman and the seven-headed, ten-horned beast she's riding. That beast you saw? It was a big deal once, then it got ghosted, but it's about to make a comeback from the underworld, only to get totally wrecked. Everyone on earth whose names weren't written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world is gonna be mind-blown when they see this beast that once was, is no longer, and is to come."

"But stay sharp," the angel said. "The seven heads are seven mountains where the woman sits. They're also seven kings. Five of them are already toast, one is still around, and the last one is coming soon, but his reign will be super short. The beast that was and then wasn't? He's an eighth king, but he's also one of the seven, and he's headed straight for destruction."

"Those ten horns you saw are ten kings who haven't gotten their power yet. They'll get to rule for a little bit with the beast, like super short-lived kings. They'll all agree to give their power to the beast and team up to fight the Lamb. But the Lamb is gonna totally own them, proving he's the King of all kings. And his crew? They're the chosen ones, the real MVPs."

Then the angel told me, "The water you saw the queen sitting on? That's all the people and nations of the world. The ten horns and the beast will eventually turn on her. They'll hate her, trash her, and leave her with nothing. They'll tear her apart and then burn what's left. It was actually God's plan all along for them to give their power to the beast until his words come true. And the woman you saw? She's the great city that bosses around all the kings of the earth."

title: The Ultimate Takedown
paragraphs: §The Fall of Babylon

Then I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He was so powerful, his glory lit up the whole earth. His voice was like thunder, and he yelled, "It's over! Babylon the Great is completely wrecked! It's nothing but a ghost town, a hangout for demons and all kinds of awful spirits and horrible birds.
"Why? Because she made everyone drink the crazy wine of her evil ways. All the world leaders partied with her, and the big-shot business guys got super rich by selling her all kinds of stuff."

Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, "Get out of there, my people! Run! You don't want to get caught up in her mess and get taken down with her. Her sins are piled up to the sky, and God's about to give her what she deserves.

"She's gonna get double the punishment for all the bad stuff she did. We're gonna make her a drink that's twice as strong as the one she made for others. She loved to show off and live it up, so now she's gonna get pain and sadness. She always bragged, 'I'm a queen, not some lonely widow. I'll never be sad.'

"Well, in one day, it's all gonna come crashing down. She's gonna get hit with death, sadness, and starvation. Then she'll be totally burned up, because the Lord God, who is judging her, is flexing his power.

"All the world leaders who partied with her and got rich off her are gonna cry and panic out when they see the smoke from her burning. They'll keep their distance because they're scared of getting burned too. They'll be like, 'Man, this is bad! The great city of Babylon, that super-strong city, got totally wrecked in just one hour!'

"And the business guys will be crying too, because no one's buying their stuff anymore. No more gold, silver, fancy jewels, or pearls. No more expensive clothes, perfumes, or fancy wood. No more ivory, bronze, iron, or marble. No more spices, incense, or fancy oils. No more wine, olive oil, flour, or wheat. No more cattle, sheep, horses, or chariots. And worst of all, no more slaves. They're totally out of business.
"'Everything you guys lived for is gone,' they'll cry. 'All your fancy stuff, all your luxury, it's all gone. You'll never see it again.'

"The businessmen who got rich from her will stand way back, scared of getting burned. They'll be crying, 'This is horrible! The great city, all dressed up in the latest fashions and covered in jewels, got wiped out in a single hour!'

"All the ship captains, sailors, and everyone who works on the sea will stand far away, crying when they see the smoke. They'll be like, 'There's never been a city like this one!' They'll throw dust on their heads and cry like it's the end of the world, 'It's over! The great city is doomed! All the ship owners got rich from her, and now she's gone in an hour!'
"Then a voice from heaven will say, 'Celebrate, everyone in heaven! All you saints, apostles, and prophets, be happy! God has finally judged her for everything she did to you.'

Then a super-strong angel picked up a huge rock, like a giant millstone, and threw it into the sea. He said, "This is what's going to happen to Babylon. She's gonna be thrown down and ghosted, never to be seen again. No more music, no more parties, no more work, no more anything. No more lights, no more weddings. Her businessmen were like the biggest tycoons, robbing the whole world. She tricked everyone with her evil magic. The only thing left of her is the blood of the prophets and saints she murdered."

title: The Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: §The Rider on the White Horse

Then I heard it—a sound like a massive concert in Heaven, with everyone roaring, "Hallelujah! God's got the power, the glory, and He's the one who saves us! He's totally fair and just in his calls." He finally brought the hammer down on the great queen of corruption who was messing up the whole world with her evil ways. He got payback for his crew that she took out.
And the crowd went wild again, shouting, "Hallelujah! The smoke from her epic takedown is going to rise forever and ever!"
The 24 bosses and the four crazy-looking creatures all bowed down and worshiped God on His throne, yelling, "Amen! Let's go! Hallelujah!"
Then a voice boomed from the throne, saying, "Everyone, give it up for our God! All of you in his squad, small and great, show him some respect!"

Then it got even louder. It sounded like a mega-choir, a roaring waterfall, and a huge thunderstorm all at once, and they were all screaming, "Hallelujah! The Boss, our God, the All-Powerful, is officially in charge! Let's party, let's celebrate, let's give him all the credit! The ultimate wedding party for the Lamb is finally here, and his bride is ready for her transformation. She was given a super lit wedding dress, all bright and clean, which represents all the awesome things God's people have done."
Then the angel told me, "Write this down: 'You're seriously lucky if you get an invite to the Lamb's wedding feast.'" And he added, "This is the real deal, straight from God."

I was so blown away that I fell down to worship the angel, but he stopped me. "Whoa, guy, don't do that," he said. "I'm just a messenger, same as you and all your friends who are all about Jesus. Worship God! The whole point of telling the future is to point to Jesus."

Then I saw Heaven crack open, and there was a white horse. Its rider was named "Faithful and True," and he's all about justice when he judges and goes to war. His eyes were like blazing fire, and he had a bunch of crowns on his head. He had a name written on him that was a total secret—only he knew what it was. He was wearing a robe that looked like it was dipped in blood, and his official title was "The Word of God." The armies of Heaven were right behind him, all on white horses and decked out in clean, white gear. A super-sharp sword came out of his mouth, ready to take down the nations, and he's going to rule them with an iron fist. He's the one who stomps the grapes in the winepress of God's mega-intense anger. On his robe and on his leg, he had a tattoo that said, **KING OF ALL KINGS AND LORD OF ALL LORDS**.

Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he yelled out to all the birds flying around, "Yo! Come on over to God's huge feast! You're going to chow down on kings, generals, and champions, on horses and their riders. It's an all-you-can-eat buffet of everyone, from the free to the enslaved, the important and the not-so-important!"

Then I saw the Beast, and he had all the world's leaders and their armies assembled, ready to throw down with the Rider on the horse and his army. But the Beast got captured, and so did his sidekick, the False Prophet, who had been doing all those fake miracles to trick people into getting the Beast's mark and worshiping his statue. Those two were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur. The rest of them were taken out by the sword that came from the mouth of the Rider on the horse. And all the birds had a massive feast on them.

title: The Final Boss Battle
paragraphs: §The Thousand Years

So I saw this epic angel drop down from heaven. He was holding the key to the Abyss—like, the ultimate timeout corner—and this massive chain. He went straight for the Dragon, you know, that ancient snake who's also the Devil and Satan. He totally owned him, chained him up for a solid thousand years, and then just chucked him into the Abyss. He slammed the door, locked it up tight, so Satan couldn't go around tricking people anymore. At least, not until the thousand years were over. After that, he gets a short hall pass.

Then I saw a bunch of thrones, and the people sitting on them were the judges. I also saw the souls of the real MVPs who got taken out because they stood up for Jesus and God's word. These were the ones who refused to worship the Beast or his statue and didn't get his mark on their foreheads or hands. They came back to life and reigned with Christ for that whole thousand years. The rest of the dead had to wait until the thousand years were done. This was the first wave of the transformation, and everyone in it was super blessed and holy. They get to skip the second death and become priests for God and Christ, ruling with him for the millennium.

When the thousand years are up, Satan gets let out of his cell. He goes right back to his old tricks, rounding up nations from every corner of the globe—even places like Gog and Magog. He convinces them to go to war and gathers this absolutely massive army, like, millions of soldiers. They swarm across the planet and surround the camp of God's people, the city He loves. But right when they get there, fire just rains down from heaven and roasts them all. And the Devil, the ultimate troll who tricked them, gets tossed into the lake of fire and brimstone. He joins the Beast and the False Prophet, and the three of them get tormented 24/7, forever and ever.

Finally, I saw this huge, glowing white throne with God sitting on it. Everything in heaven and on earth just vanished in His presence; nothing could handle it. Then I saw everyone who had ever died, great and small, all standing in front of the throne. A bunch of books were opened, and then another book, the Book of Life, was opened. Everyone was judged based on what was written in those books, on everything they had ever done. The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hell turned in theirs. Every single person was judged for their life's story. Then Death and Hell themselves got chucked into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire. And if your name wasn't written in the Book of Life, you got thrown in there too.

title: The Ultimate Transformation
paragraphs: §New Heaven and New Earth

Then I saw it. A total reboot of heaven and earth. The old heaven and earth? Gone. The sea? Ghosted. And then I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven. It was lit up and looked amazing, like a bride ready for her big day.

A super loud voice from the throne boomed, "Check it out! God is moving into the neighborhood! He's gonna live with his people. They'll be his crew, and he'll be their God. He's gonna wipe away every tear. No more death, no more sadness, no more crying, no more pain. All that old stuff is history." The one on the throne said, "Look! I'm giving everything a massive transformation. Write this down, because what I'm saying is 100% legit and you can count on it."

Then he said, "It's a done deal. I'm the A to Z, the beginning and the end. If you're thirsty, I'll give you a drink from the well of life, on the house. If you're a winner, you'll get all this. I'll be your God, and you'll be my kids. But for the cowards, the fakes, the shady ones, the murderers, the immoral, the ones into dark magic, the idol-worshippers, and all the liars - they're getting tossed into the lake of fire. That's the second death, and it's for real."

One of the seven angels with the seven last plagues came up to me and said, "Hey, come here. I'm gonna show you the Bride, the Lamb's wife." He took me in the Spirit to this huge mountain and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, shining with God's glory.

The city was sparkling like a crazy expensive gem, super clear and bright. It had a massive, high wall with twelve gates, and an angel at each gate. On the gates were the names of the twelve tribes of Israel. Three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west. The wall was built on twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the Lamb's twelve apostles.

The angel who was talking to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city, its gates, and its wall. The city was a perfect square, 1,500 miles long, wide, and high. The angel measured the wall, and it was 216 feet thick. The wall was made of jasper, and the city was pure gold, so clear you could see right through it. The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone you can imagine: jasper, sapphire, agate, emerald, onyx, carnelian, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprase, jacinth, and amethyst. The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made from a single pearl.

The main street of the city was pure gold, clear as glass. I didn't see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple. The city doesn't need the sun or the moon to light it up, because God's glory is its light, and the Lamb is its lamp. All the nations will walk in its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their bling into it. Its gates will never be shut during the day, and there's no night there. The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it. Nothing dirty will ever get in, and no one who is fake or tells lies. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life get in.

title: The Epic Finale
paragraphs: §Jesus Is Coming Soon

Then, an angel showed me this insane river, the Water-of-Life, sparkling and crystal clear. It flowed right from the throne of God and the Lamb, straight down the middle of the main street. On each side of the river, the Tree of Life was popping off, growing twelve different kinds of fruit, a new one every month. The leaves of this tree were like a super-potion for healing all the nations. Nothing would ever be cursed or messed up again. The throne of God and the Lamb was the center of everything. God's crew would be there, worshiping him 24/7. They'd get to see him face-to-face, and they'd be so connected to him it would be like they were glowing with his awesomeness. There was no night, so no need for lamps or even the sun. God's own light was so bright, it was all anyone needed. And they'd get to rule with him forever. Talk about a miraculous transformation.

The angel then told me, "Listen up, this is all legit. Every word is the real deal. God, the boss of all the prophets, sent me to give his crew a heads-up about what's about to go down. And tell them, 'I'm coming back, and it's gonna be soon!' So, you're a real one if you pay attention to what's written in this book."

I, John, am telling you, I saw and heard all of this myself. And when I did, I was so blown away that I tried to worship the angel who was showing me everything. But he was like, "Whoa, guy, get up! Don't worship me. I'm just a servant, same as you and the other prophets and everyone who's paying attention to this stuff. God is the one you worship."

The angel went on, "Don't keep this a secret. Don't just put this book on a shelf and forget about it. Time's almost up. The haters are gonna hate, and the shady people are gonna keep being shady. But the good guys need to keep being good, and the holy people need to keep being holy."

Then Jesus himself said, "Hey, I'm on my way! I'll be there soon! And I'm bringing the rewards with me. I'm gonna pay everyone back for what they've done. I'm the beginning and the end, the A to Z, the first and the last. The ones who've cleaned up their act are the real MVPs. They get to eat from the Tree of Life and walk right into the city. But all the fakes, the shady ones, the murderers, the idol-worshipers, and everyone who loves to lie and cheat? They're ghosted. They're not getting in."
"I, Jesus, sent my angel to tell all this to the churches. I'm the root and the branch of David, the bright morning star."
The Spirit and the Bride say, "Come!" And if you hear this, you should say, "Come!" too. If you're thirsty, come on over. If you want to, come and drink the Water of Life. It's totally free.

But I'm giving everyone a fair warning. If you hear what's in this book and you try to add your own stuff to it, God's gonna add all the disasters from this book to your life. And if you try to take anything away from it, God's gonna take away your spot by the Tree of Life and in the Holy City. So don't even think about it.
He who's telling you all this says it one more time: "I'm on my way! I'll be there soon!"
Yes! Come on, Master Jesus!
May the grace of the Master Jesus be with all of you. For real.
